Taiki Shuttle thoroughly enjoys her<n>race, giving
everyone a taste of her<n>aptitude for sprints and
miles along<n>the way.

Nevertheless, becoming Umamusume<n>of the Year
through sprint and mile<n>races alone will mean
climbing a very<n>steep path.

But after witnessing Taiki Shuttle's<n>full running
potential, I believe she can<n>achieve miracles.

And so, we choose to run in the mile<n>race of the
winter season, the<n>Shinzan Kinen!
